dk.name: Denmark
dk.law: Family of acts in force since 2025: NIS 2-loven (Lov nr. 434/2025), Lov om styrket beredskab i energisektoren (Lov nr. 258/2025), Lov om sikkerhed og beredskab i telesektoren and CER-loven; finance via Lov om finansiel virksomhed
dk.csirt: CFCS, Center for Cybersikkerhed, part of SAMSIK since January 2025. Reporting via virk.dk; energy-sector entities report to Energistyrelsen, and to the CSIRT as well when network and information security was compromised
dk.note: NIS2/CER arrive as a family of acts rather than one law. SAMSIK coordinates, CFCS (part of SAMSIK since January 2025) is the CSIRT, and sector authorities supervise their sectors; Energistyrelsen supervises energy, with its own reporting rules under BEK 260. SAMSIK/CFCS guidance uses skal / bør / kan tiers; map your control evidence to it.

acts.name: NIS 2-loven
acts.desc: Lov nr. 434/2025 — horizontal Danish NIS2 act

acts.name: Lov om styrket beredskab i energisektoren
acts.desc: Lov nr. 258/2025 — energy sector, NIS2 + CER combined, five preparedness levels

acts.name: Lov om sikkerhed og beredskab i telesektoren
Lov om finansiel virksomhed § 333 ff.
acts.desc: Financial sector, aligned with DORA — tick DORA above as well

reporting.trigger: Significant incident, entities under NIS 2-loven or the tele act
reporting.recipient: Via virk.dk — CSIRT function: Center for Cybersikkerhed (CFCS), part of SAMSIK

reporting.deadline: 24 h / 72 h status / 1 month incident report
reporting.recipient: Energistyrelsen; incidents that compromised network and information security also to the CSIRT, through the channel it designates; electricity, gas and hydrogen entities also alert Energinet (BEK 260 §§ 77–79)

govern.text: Registration duty on virk.dk for covered entities, per NIS 2-loven § 33.
Top management approves the preparedness plans and is accountable for them; at levels 4 and 5 the preparedness and cyber coordinator must be separate from the management that approves them.

protect.text: Every entity segments its supply-critical systems behind a DMZ or equivalent; levels 4 and 5 separate those networks physically (BEK 260 § 62).

detect.text: Levels 4 and 5 log and monitor to identify incidents in real time, respond in real time, keep logs for 13 months and hand them to their IT security service within 24 h (BEK 260 §§ 66–69).

respond.text: Report via virk.dk; drill the flow against the 24 h early-warning clock.

Report significant incidents to Energistyrelsen within 24 h, with status within 72 h and a report within one month. Exercise the preparedness plans yearly at levels 3 to 5 and every second year at level 2, with a yearly recovery exercise of supply-critical systems at levels 4 and 5 (BEK 260 §§ 21, 77–78).

dk.disclaimer: Community-maintained orientation, the reference annex for the framework. This is **not legal advice**; verify against retsinformation.dk and samsik.dk before relying on it. Corrections welcome, see [contributing](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
